mapper.select: SELECT t0.specification_id, t0.specification_name, t0.sort, CASE WHEN COUNT(t1.specification_type_id) = 0 THEN CAST('[]' AS JSON) ELSE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('specificationTypeId', t1.specification_type_id, 'specificationTypeName', t1.specification_type_name, 'specificationValues', t1.`values`)) END AS attr_and_specs FROM ms_specification AS t0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t2.specification_type_id AS specification_type_id, t2.specification_type_name AS specification_type_name, t2.specification_id AS specification_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(t1.specification_value_id) = 0 THEN CAST('[]' AS JSON) ELSE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('specificationValueId', t1.specification_value_id, 'attr', t1.attr, 'specs', t1.specs)) END AS `values` FROM ms_specification_value AS t1 JOIN ms_specification_type AS t2 ON t1.specification_type_id = t2.specification_type_id WHERE t1.del_flag=0 AND t2.del_flag=0 GROUP BY t1.specification_type_id ) AS t1 ON t0.specification_id = t1.specification_id WHERE t0.del_flag=0 GROUP BY t0.specification_id ORDER BY t0.sort

SELECT t0.specification_id, t0.specification_name, t0.sort, CASE WHEN COUNT(t1.specification_type_id) = 0 THEN CAST('[]' AS JSON) ELSE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('specificationTypeId', t1.specification_type_id, 'specificationTypeName', t1.specification_type_name, 'specificationValues', t1.`values`)) END AS attr_and_specs FROM ms_specification AS t0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t2.specification_type_id AS specification_type_id, t2.specification_type_name AS specification_type_name, t2.specification_id AS specification_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(t1.specification_value_id) = 0 THEN CAST('[]' AS JSON) ELSE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('specificationValueId', t1.specification_value_id, 'attr', t1.attr, 'specs', t1.specs)) END AS `values` FROM ms_specification_value AS t1 JOIN ms_specification_type AS t2 ON t1.specification_type_id = t2.specification_type_id WHERE t1.del_flag=0 AND t2.del_flag=0 GROUP BY t1.specification_type_id ) AS t1 ON t0.specification_id = t1.specification_id WHERE t0.del_flag=0 AND t0.specification_id = #{id} GROUP BY t0.specification_id ORDER BY t0.sort
